review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second record, target-source.json, holding the engine image digest, the resolution and the limitations. MEASURED by static analysis of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (13 byte windows, the closed list of five callers of the setter 0x5ac0a0 and the closed list of writers of the pending globals 0xa1d7cc / 0xa1d7d0, pinned in the acceptance test): the launch 0x5aef40 copies, for a weapon record with LOCK_ON (+0x74 bit 15), the three dwords the pending triple points at into projectile +0x6c/+0x70/+0x74 through lea edx,[edi+0x6c] (a store the earlier [reg+0x70] byte scan could not see); the triple is set by the setter 0x5ac0a0 from the player fire path 0x4b7193 (a free-aim triple at player+0x290, or the actor's +0x294/+0x298 filled by the message-0x10 order handler 0x498950), the gun controller 0x4b6ba1 and the fire context 0x4ab385. STILL UNMEASURED (none claimed): see the limitations array of target-source.json. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
